title: Fix PDF export to use built-in fonts, no external resources, and direct synchronous download

requirements.summary: Rewrite the pioneers PDF export utility to use jsPDF with only built-in fonts, no external resource loading, and synchronous download via jsPDF's save() method
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the PDF export button on the Pioneers page triggers an immediate file download without opening a new window or tab
No 'bad URL' errors appear in the browser console during export
No popup blocker warnings are triggered
The generated PDF uses only jsPDF built-in fonts (helvetica or equivalent)
No external HTTP requests are made during PDF generation
The PDF contains a bordered table with pioneer data (monthly hours, totals, averages, status)
PDF has black text on a white background

file_operations.description: Replace the current browser print API implementation with jsPDF library. Use only jsPDF built-in fonts (helvetica, times, courier). Generate the PDF entirely from in-memory pioneer data arrays without loading any external resources (images, fonts, assets). Create a bordered table layout showing monthly hours (September through August), totals, averages, and status per pioneer with black text on white background. Call jsPDF's save() method directly to trigger synchronous download. Remove all window.open(), window.print(), and external URL references. Handle errors gracefully without blocking the UI.
